_comment: FF-A3 (ADR-069) typed-brief fixture: the fields the operator types into the Brief tab for a ref-08-class sculpture, every one source=operator (no parser call). brief_text is the client's words. intake_id_in_fixture is the id the committed Council fixture's brief block was composed with; the real API assigns a fresh uuid, so gate_ffa3 compares the composed brief with that one token substituted and prints both ids. site.design_wind_speed_m_s = 30.0 is the same operator-typed figure the intake test suite uses — a fixture input, NOT a site measurement; the operator replaces it with the real 3-second gust for the real site. site.altitude_m 2355 is Addis Ababa (docs/operator/09_brief_intake.md). Synthetic hand-authored Council alternatives built from this brief prove replay and pipeline compatibility only — not that an AI selected the primitive from prose.
brief_text: A monumental free-standing sculpture for the entrance water court of a corporate campus in Addis Ababa. One smooth, asymmetrical hollow loop about 4.25 m tall and 2.6 m wide, welded from 316L stainless sheet and mirror polished, with a single large through-opening set slightly right of centre and a gently twisted, changing cross-section, standing on a small base plate. The sculpture itself carries no water; it stands in a still reflecting pool that is site work outside this design. The client's reference is our organic void sculpture family (reference 08). Budget ceiling ETB 6,000,000.
